info.name: ShopSphere API
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the ShopSphere REST API.

Import `ShopSphere.postman_environment.json`, select the **ShopSphere Local** environment, then run the folders in this order: **Auth → Storefront → Admin → Shop owner**.

The Auth scripts capture `adminToken`, `ownerToken`, `ownerShopId`, and `ownerShopSlug`. The Admin and Shop owner scripts create and remove QA resources while capturing their ids. The optional **Cleanup** folder revokes the captured tokens.

Requests that can upload images use `multipart/form-data` with the file field disabled. Enable the field and choose a file (jpg, jpeg, png, or webp; max 2 MB) to exercise an upload.
